results.title: Cabinet approves mining reforms to give Ghanaians a bigger stake – Lands Minister
results.snippet:
Cabinet has approved a revised Minerals and Mining Policy aimed at giving Ghanaians a bigger role in the mining sector and improving benefits for mining communities.  
   
 It has also endorsed proposed amendments to the Minerals and Mining Act for consideration by Parliament.  
   
 The Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, announced this at the Mining in Motion 2026
